title: Galois group of X^5 - X - 1 is S_5 (unconditional, via Dedekind-Frobenius)

problemStatement.formal: Construct an explicit MulEquiv galEquivS5 : (X^5 - X - 1).Gal \simeq^{*} Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), i.e. Gal(X^5 - X - 1 / \mathbb{Q}) \cong S_5, unconditionally; hence no complex root of X^5 - X - 1 is solvable by radicals.
problemStatement.plain: Selmer's trinomial X^5 - X - 1 is the canonical example of a quintic whose roots cannot be expressed with radicals. Rigorously certifying this requires proving its Galois group is the full symmetric group S_5. Unlike the sibling X^5 - 4X + 2, this polynomial has four non-real roots, so complex conjugation is a double transposition and Mathlib's prime-degree transposition shortcut does not apply. The group must instead be pinned down via the Dedekind-Frobenius theorem, reading cycle types off factorizations modulo small primes.
whyMatters: Discharges the unproved Gal \cong S_5 hypothesis of the sibling gallery entry abel-ruffini-oq-07, upgrading its conditional unsolvability result to unconditional.

X^5 - X - 1 is the textbook canonical unsolvable quintic; a machine-checked, unconditional certificate for its Galois group has independent expository value and builds the Dedekind-Frobenius bridge Mathlib currently lacks.

proven: X^5 - X - 1 is irreducible over \mathbb{Q} (irreducible mod 2).
galActionHom_bijective_of_prime_degree' pins prime-degree Galois groups to S_p when there are exactly two non-real roots -- but it does NOT apply here (four non-real roots).
The sibling entry abel-ruffini-galois-extensions-oq-01 proves Gal(X^5 - 4X + 2) \cong S_5 unconditionally using the two-non-real-root shortcut, and explicitly lists X^5 - X - 1 as open.
solvableByRad.isSolvable' plus Equiv.Perm.fin_5_not_solvable give the unsolvability corollary once the isomorphism is established.
open: The Dedekind-Frobenius theorem (factorization type of f mod an unramified prime p equals the cycle type of a Frobenius element in Gal(f/\mathbb{Q})) is not formalized in Mathlib.
Computing a \mathbb{Q}-Galois group from modular factorization data has no Mathlib automation.
Gal(X^5 - X - 1) \cong S_5 itself remains open in the gallery.
knownResults.goal: Produce a Lean 4 / Mathlib development constructing galEquivS5 : (X^5 - X - 1).Gal \simeq^{*} Equiv.Perm (Fin 5) with 0 sorries and 0 axioms, deriving root_not_solvableByRad unconditionally. This requires formalizing enough of the Dedekind-Frobenius bridge to certify a 5-cycle (from irreducibility mod 2) and a transposition (from a (2,3)-split mod 3) inside the Galois group, then applying a 'transitive + 5-cycle + transposition generate S_5' lemma.
